/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("dill").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: The package might use unsafe deserialization methods like pickle, yaml, or marshal, which can lead to arbitrary code execution.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SSL verification disabled
 * @description Disabling SSL verification allows man-in-the-middle attacks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssl-verification-disabled
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node verifyArg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["request", "get", "post", "put", "patch", "delete", "head", "options"]).getACall() and
  verifyArg = call.getArgByName("verify") and
  (
    verifyArg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = false
    or
    verifyArg.asExpr().(IntegerLiteral).getValue() = 0
  )
select call, "SSL verification is explicitly disabled."
findings.hypothesis: The code might disable SSL verification in HTTP requests, allowing Man-in-the-Middle attacks.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
 * @description Making network requests with untrusted URLs can lead to SSRF
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/ssrf
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module SSRFConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("get").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("post").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("put").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("delete").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("head").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("patch").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("request").getACall() or
      call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember("Session").getACall().getReturn().getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "head", "patch", "request"]).getACall()
      |
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module SSRFFlow = TaintTracking::Global<SSRFConfig>;
import SSRFFlow::PathGraph

from SSRFFlow::PathNode source, SSRFFlow::PathNode sink
where SSRFFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential SSRF from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: The package might perform network requests using URLs derived from untrusted input, leading to SSRF.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
 * @description Logging sensitive information such as tokens or passwords can lead to information disclosure.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/sensitive-logging
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-532
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["debug", "info", "warning", "error", "critical", "exception"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(_) and
  exists(string name |
    name = arg.asExpr().(Name).getId() and
    (
      name.matches("%password%") or
      name.matches("%token%") or
      name.matches("%secret%") or
      name.matches("%key%") or
      name.matches("%auth%")
    ) and
    not name.matches("%public%")
  )
select call, "Potential logging of sensitive information via variable '" + arg.asExpr().(Name).getId() + "'."
findings.hypothesis: Logging of sensitive information like tokens or keys.
